playerText.title: Chapter 1: The Empty Convoy
playerText.summary: Respond to Relief Convoy Twelve, protect its people, and bring the immediate crisis to a responsible disposition.
Relief Convoy Twelve is powered but silent, with a fragmented distress packet and people in need of assistance.
The convoy's quarantine order carries technically valid Starfleet authority markers but does not match current routing and requires verification.
Initial contact locates survivors off the convoy, identifies a Compact custody dispute around convoy officers, and confirms secured emergency hardware is missing.
The preserved records and recovery lead connect the missing emergency hardware to a false order containing authentic Starfleet code fragments, while the wider source remains unknown.
Captain Nella Ivers can testify that a technically authenticated quarantine order directed the evacuation and that secured transponder modules disappeared during the resulting dispersal.
Dr. Samira Nadi's incomplete patient manifest and Olan Brin's cargo-release record independently place survivors and missing emergency hardware under the same false clearance chain.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose communicates the Relief Convoy Twelve distress situation and the immediate need for assistance.
exclusions: Naming the convoy, anticipating a future assignment, or mentioning the Asterion Reach does not communicate the active emergency.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose tells the player that the quarantine authority appears technically valid but conflicts with current routing and needs verification.
exclusions: The distress call, a generic quarantine warning, suspicion of deception, or an officer beginning a check does not disclose the routing conflict.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts enough completed contact, remote access, boarding, rescue access, records work, or equivalent operational examination for the crew to finish a reliable initial assessment.
exclusions: Approaching, one isolated scan, assigning a team, stating an intention, or making contact without a reliable operational assessment does not complete this event.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose communicates the material combined discovery: survivors are off the convoy, convoy officers face a Compact custody claim, and secured emergency hardware is missing.
exclusions: Any one isolated detail, an unresolved search, a vague inventory problem, or director-only knowledge does not communicate the aggregate dispersal picture.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts usable records, telemetry, witness evidence, or recovered material actually obtained through a lawful, technical, diplomatic, or investigative route.
exclusions: Wanting the hardware found, opening a search route, ordering an investigation, locating an unverified signal, or accusing a party does not mean usable recovery evidence was obtained.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when Ivers gives a usable account connecting the authenticated evacuation order, the crew's dispersal, and the disappearance of secured transponder modules.
exclusions: Knowing Ivers commands the convoy, locating her, or hearing that she distrusted the order is not her usable testimony.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when Ivers's statement is actually recorded and preserved as usable recovery evidence.
exclusions: An informal conversation, an anticipated interview, or unrecorded hearsay is not obtained evidence.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when Nadi's patient manifest and Brin's cargo record are compared and explicitly link the dispersal and missing hardware to one clearance chain.
exclusions: Either incomplete record alone, a head count, or a cargo shortage without the cross-reference is not the survivor-and-cargo manifest picture.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when the cross-referenced patient and cargo records are preserved as usable recovery evidence.
exclusions: Requesting records or observing discrepancies without preserving the comparison is not obtained evidence.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when the player or a delegated officer actually opens a bounded custody discussion with Compact personnel before imposing a final authority disposition.
exclusions: A demand, threat, unanswered hail, or unilateral transfer order is not an opened custody negotiation.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose communicates that preserved records and a concrete recovery lead connect the missing emergency hardware to a false order containing authentic Starfleet code fragments, without claiming the wider source is known.
exclusions: A suspicious signal, a missing component, a routing mismatch, an accusation, or a theory without the combined evidence does not establish this picture.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts the actual disposition of the people endangered by the convoy emergency.

values.guidance: The endangered people reach a safe disposition without a material cost.
The endangered people reach safety with injuries, delay, damage, or another material cost recorded.
A competent authority actually assumes the remaining relief responsibility.
The relief effort fails after a material risk was known and a course of action was deliberately committed.

exclusions: A rescue order, approach, plan, attempted contact, optimistic statement, or player assertion does not establish the relief result.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts the committed disposition of the conflicting quarantine authority after its evidentiary significance is known.

values.guidance: Starfleet and Compact participants commit a lawful shared disposition of the authority conflict.
Starfleet lawfully contains and records the authority conflict without a shared Compact disposition.
The authority conflict is contained with a material jurisdictional, security, evidentiary, or humanitarian cost.
The evidence and authority question are actually transferred to a competent authority.
Further action on the known authority conflict is explicitly declined and the immediate consequences are recorded.
The authority response fails after a known material risk is deliberately accepted.

exclusions: Initial posture, negotiation still underway, a unilateral demand not yet enforced, suspicion, or a proposed record does not establish the final authority disposition.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts the actual disposition of the missing emergency hardware after the recovery and authentication picture is known.

values.guidance: The hardware is recovered or secured under credible joint custody.
A lawful competent authority secures the hardware without joint custody.
The hardware is recovered with damage, lost telemetry, injury, jurisdictional rupture, or another material cost.
A competent authority actually assumes responsibility for recovering or securing the hardware.
Further action on the known hardware risk is explicitly declined and the unresolved consequence is recorded.
The hardware or its usable evidence is lost after a known risk is deliberately accepted.

exclusions: Locating a signal, starting pursuit, requesting custody, finding a container, or declaring success without depicted custody does not establish the hardware disposition.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts the actual record or explicit disposition of the optional shared-record opportunity.

values.guidance: Starfleet and Compact participants create or commit a credible shared incident record.
Starfleet creates a usable record without Compact participation.
The surviving record is materially divided, contested, or incomplete.
The player knowingly declines to pursue a shared record after the opportunity is understood.

exclusions: Opening talks, intending to document events, sharing one datum, or requesting cooperation does not establish a completed record.

playerText.summary: The quarantine order carries valid Starfleet authority markers but conflicts with current routing and requires verification.
Survivors are off the convoy, Compact personnel hold convoy officers under a custody claim, and secured emergency transponder hardware is missing.
Preserved records and recovery evidence connect the missing emergency hardware to a false order containing authentic Starfleet code fragments; the wider source remains unknown.
Captain Ivers can give a firsthand account of the evacuation order and the missing secured modules.
The relief physician and cargo custodian hold incomplete records that become probative when compared.
The Breckenridge completed a reliable initial operational assessment of the convoy emergency.
The crew obtained usable evidence connecting the missing hardware, convoy records, and authority conflict.
A bounded custody discussion with Compact personnel began before the final authority disposition.
The committed disposition of the convoy relief effort.
The committed disposition of the conflicting quarantine authority.
The committed disposition of the missing emergency hardware.
The disposition of the optional shared incident record.

playerText.title: Protect the people of Relief Convoy Twelve
playerText.summary: Bring the endangered convoy personnel to a safe disposition or place their care with a competent authority.

terminal.text: The endangered convoy personnel reached safety.
The endangered convoy personnel reached safety with a material cost recorded.
A competent authority assumed the remaining relief responsibility.
The relief effort failed after a known risk was deliberately accepted.

playerText.title: Resolve the conflicting quarantine authority
playerText.summary: Establish a lawful disposition for the conflicting order and preserve what can be learned from it.

terminal.text: The conflicting authority received a lawful disposition.
The conflicting authority was contained with a material cost recorded.
The authority question and its evidence were placed with a competent authority.
Further action on the known authority conflict was knowingly declined.
The authority response failed after a known risk was deliberately accepted.

playerText.title: Account for the missing emergency hardware
playerText.summary: Recover, secure, or responsibly transfer the known emergency hardware risk.

terminal.text: The missing emergency hardware was recovered or secured.
The emergency hardware was recovered with a material cost recorded.
A competent authority assumed responsibility for the missing hardware.
Further action on the known hardware risk was knowingly declined.
The hardware or its usable evidence was lost after a known risk was accepted.

playerText.title: Establish a shared incident record with the Compact
playerText.summary: Invite credible local participation in the record of the convoy crisis.

terminal.text: Starfleet and Compact participants established a shared incident record.
A usable but limited or fragmented incident record survived.
The opportunity to establish a shared record was knowingly declined.

commandBearingAwards.reason: You established a credible shared incident record instead of leaving the known dispute fragmented.

playerText.title: The convoy crisis closes with a serious consequence
playerText.summary: The campaign continues with the informed failure or knowingly unresolved risk carried into the record.

playerText.title: The convoy crisis is contained with cost
playerText.summary: The immediate crisis has a responsible disposition, with material costs or transferred obligations carried forward.

playerText.title: A cooperative convoy resolution
playerText.summary: Lives, evidence, and authority were protected through a credible shared record with local participation.

playerText.title: The empty convoy answered
playerText.summary: The people, conflicting authority, and missing hardware received responsible dispositions.

target.playerSafeSetup: At Asterion Station, a Compact patrol reports being attacked by a vessel identifying itself as the U.S.S. Breckenridge.

mustNarrate: Acknowledge the committed relief, authority, and hardware dispositions.
Carry forward the shared-record outcome only if it was actually established.
Introduce the Compact patrol report at Asterion Station.
mustNotReveal: Do not identify the source, operator, or purpose of the impersonating vessel.
Do not imply Compact cooperation if no shared record was established.
Do not convert an unresolved Chapter 1 cost into a clean success.
